purpose: Direction gate for deciding which-side TL is eligible to draw on each source timeframe.

terms.HL: A timeframe-local pair of horizontal decision lines derived from the two most recent 38%-confirmed alternating pivots: one HIGH-side HL and one LOW-side HL.
terms.TL: Trendline candidate drawn in the direction allowed by the HL decision gate.
terms.retracement_38: Minimum retracement used to recognize/confirm a reaction Turn/Pivot. It is NOT the HL price.

rule.before_hl_break: Keep the trend-following TL direction that was valid before the HL break.
rule.after_hl_break: When price breaks the timeframe-local HL, switch eligibility to the TL on the breakout side.
rule.scope: Evaluate independently on each source timeframe before Plan-B display copying.
rule.display_copy: After a source timeframe selects its TL, copy the exact selected geometry to its Plan-B display timeframe(s); do not re-decide direction on the destination chart.
rule.hl_display: Always draw both HIGH-side and LOW-side HL lines whether price has broken either line or not.

important: There are two HL sides: one above and one below the current structure.
For a falling example, the working pair is the recent confirmed LOW and the previous confirmed HIGH.
For a rising example, the working pair is the recent confirmed HIGH and the previous confirmed LOW.
Both HL lines are always drawn, before and after any break.
Each HL anchor must already be a Turn/Pivot confirmed by the existing 38% reaction rule.
38% is reaction/Turn confirmation only; 38% itself is not an HL price.
HL break-to-TL switching is still not automated until video comparison confirms the pair selection and breakout semantics.
Plan-B destination charts do not reinterpret source-timeframe HL decisions.

candidate_rule.falling_example: recent confirmed LOW + one previous confirmed HIGH
candidate_rule.rising_example: recent confirmed HIGH + one previous confirmed LOW

research_candidate.display_scope: source timeframe chart only during validation
